claims.summary: The Japan Foundation states that a verb’s non-past affirmative plain-form is its dictionary form and illustrates it with 買います/買う, 抑えます/抑える, します/する, and 来ます/来る.

locator.description: Elementary 1, Lesson 15, PDF pp. 111–112 (printed L15-21/22): plain-form vs plain-style distinction; non-past affirmative plain-form is dictionary-form; pairs 買います/買う, 抑えます/抑える, します/する, 来ます/来る.

links.notes: Cotejo semántico directo con recurso didáctico primario gratuito.
